notes: Capture now recognizes 14 more devices that used to show up as unknown in the session badge and in Stats for Nerds: Logitech G Pro (PlayStation) and RS50, PXN VD10, Simagic P1000 and P2000 Haptic pedals, Moza CRP2, Heusinkveld Sim Pedals Ultimate, Simjack, SimRuito, PRS and Simsonn Plus X pedals, the DS-8X shifter and the G-TEC G29 shifter adapter. Nothing changes in what leaves your PC: still only brand and model.
notas: O Capture passa a reconhecer 14 equipamentos que apareciam como desconhecidos no selo da sessão e no Stats for Nerds: Logitech G Pro (PlayStation) e RS50, PXN VD10, pedais Simagic P1000 e P2000 Haptic, Moza CRP2, Heusinkveld Sim Pedals Ultimate, pedais Simjack, SimRuito, PRS e Simsonn Plus X, o shifter DS-8X e o adaptador de câmbio G29 da G-TEC. Nada muda no que sai do seu PC: continua sendo só marca e modelo.
